python_sdk_prerequisite.gate: s3.py require_sdk_models checks all native-consumer operation names for s3/s3control/kms/iam/sqs/cloudwatch locally, before any module file write, Terraform call or resource mutation.
python_sdk_prerequisite.failure_behavior: One explicit prerequisite failure lists every missing service/operation. No ABAC skip, compatibility fallback or passing stage.
python_sdk_prerequisite.execution_evidence: The static inventory does not establish runtime success; inspect completed stages and failures in the retained report.

service_time: Each verify advances about99days for daily inventory, lifecycle and90/91-day intelligent tiering; only isolated temporary prefixes expire/archive. Noncurrent expiry is timed from the observed delete-marker creation, not the original object's expiration eligibility.

SQS events consumed/deleted before the 90day advance. Temporary locks removed with exact version/hold-off/governance bypass. Retained Terraform KMS objects are stable across arbitrary later module service-time advances.
Owned KMS destroy schedules seven-day deletion; cleanup advances eightdays and asserts key NotFound, rather than treating PendingDeletion as deletion.
state_safety: Every control state-rm/import saves prior owned local state bytes in a private0600 file. Failure restores prior bytes and performs normal Terraform owned destroy; no state removal used for teardown.
strict_failure_retention: Only a strict exit2 with explicit no-change stdout and saved JSON containing no resource/drift/output changes is retained as a typed failure. All other differences/errors stop immediately. Retained failures remain terminal after independent safe imports, update and SQLite/controller reopen; no failed strict stage is reported as passed. Every phase has separate binary plans, private JSON/check receipts and captured command stdout/exit evidence.
payload_receipts: Each initial/updated/reopen native-evidence JSON records actual decrypted Terraform object/copy byte lengths and SHA256, their real KMS key ARN and exact owned bucket/access-point scope before strict checks.
account_isolation: The owned runner accepts --account-id for a separate twelve-digit local account; it supplies the same account to both controller lifetimes and Terraform inputs. Fresh directories, SQLite and unoccupied ports remain mandatory.
readback_observation: Before separate strict checks, an ordinary saved refresh-only plan observes the parent resources' separately managed configuration and empty-map readback. Saved JSON must contain no managed configuration actions or deferred work; observed addresses/fields must match the fixture's exact evidence-based allowlist. Each phase records the full private JSON and changed-field receipt before applying that state-only plan. Subsequent strict refresh and ordinary plans are independent; ongoing or unrelated drift still fails.
routing: Explicit sts/iam/kms/s3/s3control/sqs/sns/cloudwatch endpoints. Account discovery enabled. Provider http_proxy=endpoint, https_proxy empty, no_proxy127.0.0.1,localhost; SDK AP/control clients use same listener preserving generated Host.
abac_tag_mutation: An ABAC-enabled general purpose bucket rejects PutBucketTagging. The current-policy consumer changes and restores its Revision tag with signed S3 Control TagResource through the owned listener. It still requires the limited identity to lose access while the tag differs.
boundaries: Analytics selection is config-only because existing owner has no report job; no analysis report success stage.
Requester-pays consumer is owner-exempt only; cross-account charge admission is unverified without second-account authority.
Directory bucket resource explicitly rejected by current owner, ListDirectoryBuckets absent; no directory bucket fabricated.
S3 metadata tables, grants, Outposts buckets, directory access-point scopes, MRAP, Object Lambda and Storage Lens missing APIs listed per exact type below.
SSE-S3 and SSE-KMS use real owner cryptography. Positive DSSE and Bucket Key cryptography are unavailable, never admitted as header-only success.
No geographic transfer acceleration, billing, durability, cloud capacity or native-engine claim inferred from this local fixture.
